notes.title: 1.1 Released! - Big Update!
notes.content:
The latest version of VR Baseball is available NOW!

The game has been rebuilt with new graphics, a much larger stadium, and even a new game mode!

Leaderboards are in, achievements were expanded, and it's been filled with lots of extra FUN!

Hop in and play today!

notes.title: 1.1 Beta Available Now
notes.content:
Today I'm happy to announce VR Baseball 1.1 Beta is available.  This is a big update with many changes!

Changes

New Art & Stadium
Leaderboards
Doubled the # of Achievements
Updated Sound Effects
Golf Mode
Post Round Stats
More Fireworks
Difficulty Adjustments (Pro is harder, Easy is easier)


To try it out, just switch to the beta branch.
